notes: Exact-model Electro-Voice ZLX-12P powered loudspeaker; source is the 2015.12 / 02 / F.01U.319.253 ZLX Series user manual (not the later ZLX-12P-G2). It specifies a full-space 65 Hz–18 kHz (-3 dB) response using the Music DSP preset, 50 Hz–20 kHz (-10 dB), 126 dB maximum SPL, 90° × 60° coverage, a 1,000 W power rating, an EVS-12K 12-inch woofer, and DH-1K HF driver. The manual's response table lists separate Live, Music, Speech, and Club modes; no mode-specific response points are selected as a generic curve. Sensitivity and passive impedance are not specified for this powered model and remain N/A. Coverage is nominal only, not a polar/directivity dataset. Source: https://www.leone.sk/file/230/ev-zlx-manual.pdf.
